topic: Horse that set standing Triple Crown race records
core_question: Which racehorse won the 1973 Triple Crown with times in the Kentucky Derby and Belmont Stakes that still stand as records?
answer_summary: The answer must name Secretariat, the 1973 Triple Crown-winning racehorse whose Kentucky Derby and Belmont Stakes times still stand.
